verdict.rationale: Okta documents substantial public REST APIs (SCIM CRUD API, Event Hooks, Admin Management APIs referenced by the MCP server) with clear developer docs, showing a genuine documented public API surface. However, probes show no discoverable machine-readable spec (llms.txt 404, docs-md 404, openapi.json/swagger.json all 404 across candidate paths), meaning AI-native/agentic consumption relies on human-oriented docs rather than a standard machine-consumable API description. missing for 10: llms.txt or OpenAPI/Swagger spec discoverable at conventional endpoints, independent confirmation of API completeness beyond vendor docs.
